description: Bridges is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. Polylines representing bridges throughout Pierce County with attribution provided from mobility data maintained by Pierce County. Please read metadata for additional information ( Any data download constitutes acceptance of the Terms of Use (. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The table has 62 columns. The portal shows 2024-07-05 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
